summary: Icon Energy Corp, a Greek-based Nasdaq-listed dry bulk operator, furnished a Form 6-K press release disclosing an agreement to acquire approximately 2.8% of a vessel-owning entity holding a 2023-built 1,800 TEU ECO container feeder chartered to a major liner operator at a fixed $24,750/day through February 2028, generating roughly $12 million of Minimum Contracted Revenue. The minority stake, funded from cash and expected to close by end-October 2026 pending definitive documentation, is a passive co-investment alongside a consortium led by a containership owner that will manage the vessel commercially and technically; Icon gains a board appointment. This is an ordinary portfolio co-investment rather than a special situation, with no change of control, tender, or shareholder action; watch execution and shipping-market conditions.
